WHERE ulh.office_seq = #{officeSeq}
AND NOT OR AND
(to_char(ulh.create_at::timestamp, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{filter.startDate} AND #{filter.endDate})
AND NOT OR AND
uli.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.value}, '%')
AND NOT OR AND
ulh.login_ip::text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.value}, '%')
AND NOT OR AND
uui.user_name_ko LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.value}, '%')
AND uui.user_name_en LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.value}, '%')
AND NOT OR AND
ulh.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.value}, '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT ulh.user_mst_seq , ulh.login_history_seq , to_char(ulh.create_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_at , ulh.login_ip , ulh.category , uli.user_id , uui.user_name_ko , uui.user_name_en , uui.user_name_zh , ulh.login_success_yn , ulh.login_device_type , ulh.login_country , ulh.login_type , ulh.note FROM utb_login_history ulh LEFT JOIN utb_user_info uui ON ulh.user_mst_seq = uui.user_mst_seq LEFT JOIN utb_login_info uli ON ulh.user_mst_seq = uli.user_mst_seq
ORDER BY ulh.create_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offSet}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM utb_login_history ulh LEFT JOIN utb_user_info uui ON ulh.user_mst_seq = uui.user_mst_seq LEFT JOIN utb_login_info uli ON ulh.user_mst_seq = uli.user_mst_seq
